name: task-list
title: Task list
description: The hub of a long application: every section as a link with its status in words and a shape, a count of what is done, and a reason for what cannot start yet.
docs: Pass sections ({ id, title, href, status, hint }). status is completed, in-progress, not-started, needs-attention or cannot-start. The first four are links when they have an href, with the status as a pill: a disc with a check, a half-filled ring, a dashed ring, a disc with an exclamation mark. A section that cannot start is plain text with a lock and its hint, which is the reason, and has nothing to follow. The status and the hint are part of each link's accessible name ("Business details, In progress, 2 of 3 people added"). heading names the region and showSummary adds "3 of 6 sections complete" with a bar of one segment per section. onNavigate receives the section and the click event: call preventDefault to route it yourself. Rows are at least 56px tall; from 28rem of room the status becomes a column of its own. labels translates every word and locale writes the numbers.
